summary: `apply.py` wrote all 214 maps on a scratch copy of the plane with no failure, and a second run refused every map (SHA-1 changed). Byte check (`tools/check_bytes.py`): only the planned lines changed - 556 moved-waypoint lines (x/y only), 11 route values, 6 route lines removed, 4 added waypoint lines, 2 `nextobjectid`s - with every line ending kept, and the other 214 maps byte-identical. `waypoint_routes_qa.py`: 22 -> 19 maps with findings, nothing new (the 3 that went are routes this plan changed for other reasons). `validate_plane_data.py`: exit 0, report identical except `enemy-routes` 1360 -> 1354 (the 6 dropped routes); no ref-waypoint finding. `booster_guards.py`: identical, 260 of 261 boosters guarded; chests by round 286's definition: 528 of 534 guarded, unchanged (no enemy post moved). Loot with an enemy present (standing within 3 tiles or a patrol stop within 2): 749 before, 749 after - the one chest that loses its patroller (crypt.tmx chest 54) never had it in play: that wizard's route froze at its post. Every running route whose first waypoint is its post (178) has a path from that waypoint's own vertex (`tools/verify_post_start.py`) - the check that caught one bad candidate (zedruu #212) before it shipped.
